description: Formalizes future evaluation-leakage constraints: duplicate groups never split, same-prompt leakage controlled, the 270 scored block protected, unknown learner IDs acknowledged, versioned partition logic, and domain scoping. Includes a reusable partition-plan validator. No final split is created.

statements.statement: Duplicate-group members must never be split across development/evaluation boundaries.
The same prompt must not be split across dev/eval without an explicit prompt-matching design with recorded justification.
The 270 scored expository block moves as one unit and is protected from development use.
No partition may claim learner-level isolation from WECCL filenames; duplicate detection is the only proxy.
Every partition must be versioned and reproducible from document_id plus grouping keys (prompt_id, genre, duplicate_group_id, timed_status, grade, major_type, entry_year).
Exports and partitions are domain-scoped by default; unknown domain values are rejected or quarantined.
Any evaluation design touching corpus data must pass the reusable partition-plan validator before execution.
No final benchmark split is created by this policy; its purpose is preventing accidental leakage.
The prototype student-level splitter is infrastructure tooling, not a research partition authority; research partitions must satisfy this policy.
